name: Five-pillar analysis
purpose: To present five distinct dimensions or categories of a strategic analysis surrounding a central core concept.
use_when: Use when you need to break down a central topic into five specific analytical dimensions or question sets.
avoid_when: Avoid when you have more or fewer than five key points, or when the content requires a linear sequence rather than a hub-and-spoke relationship.
notes: The layout is strictly balanced around a central circle; ensure text in the five surrounding boxes is concise to avoid overlapping the center element.
